_comment: Copy to roles/<role_id>.json. The roles/ directory is gitignored.
title: Senior Backend Engineer
openness: Open to fully remote roles in Europe and relocation to Dublin for the right opportunity.
_openness_note: Shown on the CV banner under the headline. Overrides profile.openness. Remove this key to inherit the profile-level default.

location_strategy._comment: Optional per-role override of profile.location_strategy_defaults. Same keys and values. Set 'inherit' to fall through to the profile-level default; omit a key to inherit implicitly. Supported values: inherit, hide, remote_label, current_residence, country_only, role_location, custom:<key>, generated_role_specific.

availability_banner: Available for immediate start in Europe timezone.
_availability_banner_note: Optional. Rendered verbatim when 'location_strategy.availability_banner' is 'generated_role_specific'. Consumed by the resolver, not by cv_builder directly.
_additional_experience_note: Set to [] to suppress the condensed 'Earlier experience:' line for this role (e.g. tight one-page submission). Remove the key entirely to inherit profile.additional_experience. Rendered as one condensed paragraph, not full entry blocks.

custom_answers.why_company: Optional free-text answer for a specific 'Why us?' field

paragraphs: Opening paragraph — specific hook to the company/role...
Paragraph 3 — fit with this specific JD, address key requirements...

experience_overrides._comment: Optional: override specific bullets for this role. Leave empty to use profile defaults.

bullets: Overridden bullet 1 specific to this application...

_jd_skills_note: Optional. Skills lifted verbatim from the JD. cv_builder intersects these with profile.skills (case-insensitive match, exact string) and only renders categories with ≥1 hit, padded from profile order to a floor of 4 items. Never invents skills outside profile.json. Remove the key entirely to render the profile's skills in declared order, still capped at 6 categories × 6 items.
notes: Add any notes about this application here — e.g. referral contact, deadline, status.
